dedupe_keys.name: mexico housing supply registered in the unique housing register sedatu ruv

description: Secretaría de Desarrollo Agrario, Territorial y Urbano (SEDATU), Mexico publishes information on the housing supply registered in the Registro Único de Vivienda (RUV), with an inventory of housing of the national housing information system, the housing registered in the RUV and days of inventory. Coverage: Mexico nationwide; the portal record was created and last modified on 2026-06-25 and the three CSV files are served from the ministry data repository. Format and access: CSV, downloadable without registration from the Mexican open data portal (datos.gob.mx); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the geographic level (state, municipality or housing project), the time span and the fields are unconfirmed; the register covers new housing that is registered for financing, not the whole stock. Simulation uses: housing supply and vacancy inputs for urban growth, demand and exposure scenarios in agent-based housing-market models. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
